title: Track ignition/deployments/ in git (public deployment data)

options.name: Track all of ignition/deployments/ in git after the SAFE-01 backup verifies
options.behavior_impact: No trading behavior change. The deployment journals and artifacts become versioned, through scoped un-ignore rules for ignition/deployments/** only (NAC-02).
options.risk: Public deployment data (addresses, bytecode, build info, journals) enters git history permanently. None of it is secret; the NAC-01 scans cover the backup set.

options.name: Keep current behavior: journals and artifacts stay untracked
options.risk: Irreplaceable deployment state exists only on one disk

recommendation: Track, after the SAFE-01 backup verifies (research recommendation).
default: Keep current (untracked) until the SAFE-01 backup verifies
behavior_impact: None on trading; repository content only

decided.ruling: track all of ignition/deployments/ in git after the SAFE-01 backup verifies
